globalEvents.title: SUCCESS
globalEvents.message: Helldivers successfully held ZEA RUGOSIA against Illuminate hostiles, enabling construction of the CMC to begin on schedule. Early reports from the mental health initiatives show promise, with SEAF personnel especially appreciating therapeutic activities such as the Illuminate live-fire range. The elimination of 215,000,000 Voteless provided valuable data for the development of a neural implant that prevents short-term memories from becoming long-term ones, defending SEAF minds from lasting exposure to Illuminate propaganda. Volunteers fitted with prototype implants described Voteless combat footage recorded by Helldivers in vivid detail. By the following morning, none could recall having seen it. Stakeholders were thrilled by the military and commercial potential of the technology. Full production will begin immediately.

globalEvents.title: FIELD SALVAGE
globalEvents.message: With ZEA RUGOSIA secured, construction of the CMC is underway with construction forces composed of SEAF on an outdoor wellness retreat. Super Earth continues to monitor the Voteless population spikes on ALAMAK VII and ALAIRT III. The continuing enemy surge requires far greater SEAF presence to support the Helldivers, increasing demand for the production of the neural implants. While expensive, each implant costs several Super Credits less than training new SEAF, and is considerably more affordable than implementing radical work-life balance countermeasures. To further lower the project's economic impact, Helldivers are ordered to eliminate 135,000,000 Troopers, 2,000,000 Factory Striders, 250,000,000 of Terminids and 25,000,000 Bile Spewers.
